name: EIPOWER
recent: EI Power 近期以 RM17.2 million 收购位于 Glenmarie 的工厂作为新总部，并获媒体报导致力于下半年争取更多合约。公司于 2026 年 5 月上市后持续进行企业活动，最新季度业绩已公布。
notable: 全资子公司 EI Power Technologies 以 RM17.2 million 收购位于 Selangor Glenmarie 的永久地契土地及两层半半独立式工厂。
媒体报道公司下半年合约增加，并计划将新收购物业作为新总部。
risks: 大股东 Siew Wei Foo 的持股出现变动，需留意后续股权变化。

Newly listed EI Power buys Glenmarie property for new HQ

recent_en: EI Power recently acquired a factory in Glenmarie for RM17.2 million as its new headquarters, with media reports noting higher contract wins expected to support 2H26. The company has been active on corporate exercises since its May 2026 listing, and its latest quarterly results have been released.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary EI Power Technologies acquired a freehold land and a two-and-a-half storey semi-detached factory in Glenmarie, Selangor for RM17.2 million.
Media reported higher contract wins for 2H26 and plans to use the newly acquired property as the new headquarters.
risks_en: There was a change in the shareholding of substantial shareholder Siew Wei Foo, warranting attention to subsequent shareholding changes.
